steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /workspace/
file /workspace/* 2>/dev/null
echo "---"
find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n'
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
echo "=== base db ==="
python3 -c "
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('main.db')
print(c.execute('select * from items').fetchall())
print(c.execute('select name,sql from sqlite_master').fetchall())
"
echo "=== WAL header hex ==="
xxd main.db-wal | head -40
echo "=== WAL header parsed ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
d=open('/workspace/main.db-wal','rb').read()
h=struct.unpack('>IIIIIIII', d[:32])
print('magic %08x version %d pagesize %d ckpt %d salt %08x %08x cksum %08x %08x'%h)
ps=h[2]
print('size',len(d),'frames',(len(d)-32)/(ps+24))
for i in range((len(d)-32)//(ps+24)):
    off=32+i*(ps+24)
    pg,commit,s1,s2,c1,c2=struct.unpack('>IIIIII',d[off:off+24])
    print(i+1,'page',pg,'commit',commit,'salt',hex(s1),hex(s2),'cks',hex(c1),hex(c2))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
find / -xdev -name '*main.db*' -o -name '*.db-wal' 2>/dev/null | head -50
echo "---lost+found---"
ls -la /workspace/lost+found
echo "---mounts---"
mount | grep -E 'workspace|app'
echo "---all small dbs---"
find / -xdev \( -name '*.db' -o -name '*.sqlite*' -o -name '*.wal' \) 2>/dev/null | head -100
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
ls -la /opt/testbed-src/
md5sum /opt/testbed-src/main.db /workspace/main.db
cp /opt/testbed-src/main.db-wal /workspace/main.db-wal
ls -la
xxd main.db-wal | head -20
python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
d=open('/workspace/main.db-wal','rb').read()
h=struct.unpack('>IIIIIIII', d[:32])
print('magic %08x version %d pagesize %d ckpt %d salt %08x %08x cksum %08x %08x'%h)
ps=h[2]
print('size',len(d),'frames',(len(d)-32)/(ps+24))
for i in range((len(d)-32)//(ps+24)):
    off=32+i*(ps+24)
    pg,commit,s1,s2,c1,c2=struct.unpack('>IIIIII',d[off:off+24])
    print(i+1,'page',pg,'commit',commit,'salt',hex(s1),hex(s2),'cks',hex(c1),hex(c2))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
raw=open('/opt/testbed-src/main.db-wal','rb').read()
d=bytes(b^0x42 for b in raw)
open('/workspace/main.db-wal','wb').write(d)
h=struct.unpack('>IIIIIIII', d[:32])
print('magic %08x version %d pagesize %d ckpt %d salt %08x %08x cksum %08x %08x'%h)
ps=h[2]
n=(len(d)-32)//(ps+24)
print('size',len(d),'pagesize',ps,'frames',n)
for i in range(n):
    off=32+i*(ps+24)
    pg,commit,s1,s2,c1,c2=struct.unpack('>IIIIII',d[off:off+24])
    print(i+1,'page',pg,'commit',commit,'salt',hex(s1),hex(s2),'cks',hex(c1),hex(c2))
PY
echo "=== read db ==="
python3 -c "
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('main.db')
print(c.execute('select * from items').fetchall())
"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
ls -la
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json
c=sqlite3.connect('/workspace/main.db')
rows=[{"id":r[0],"name":r[1],"value":r[2]} for r in c.execute('SELECT id,name,value FROM items ORDER BY id')]
with open('/workspace/recovered.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(rows,f)
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
print('count',len(rows))
c.close()
PY
echo "=== final ls ==="
ls -la /workspace/
cat /workspace/recovered.json
echo
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
# restore decrypted WAL (XOR 0x42)
python3 - <<'PY'
raw=open('/opt/testbed-src/main.db-wal','rb').read()
open('/workspace/main.db-wal','wb').write(bytes(b^0x42 for b in raw))
PY
# Verify with a scratch copy so the final files aren't checkpointed/deleted
rm -rf /tmp/verify && mkdir /tmp/verify
cp main.db main.db-wal /tmp/verify/
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json
c=sqlite3.connect('/tmp/verify/main.db')
rows=[{"id":r[0],"name":r[1],"value":r[2]} for r in c.execute('SELECT id,name,value FROM items ORDER BY id')]
c.close()
print('rows read with WAL present:', len(rows))
print(rows)
expected=json.load(open('/workspace/recovered.json'))
print('JSON matches DB:', rows==expected)
PY
echo "=== final files ==="
ls -la /workspace
xxd -l 8 /workspace/main.db-wal
EOF
